name: Madame Enigma
source:
Madame Enigma is a cunning manipulator with a macabre and unsettling sense of humor. Capable of assuming different identities, she lures enemies into ingenious traps, armed with bizarre devices of her own invention, like invisible traps or lethal mechanisms hidden in every corner. Ruthless, she leaves cryptic clues behind her, turning every encounter into a deadly game, where every move is a puzzle to be solved to survive.

[In game description]
